name: McCauley 1C160/DTM7557, 2-blade fixed pitch, 75 in, 57 in pitch (Cessna 172P / Reims F172P, Lycoming O-320-D2J)

sourced.blades_diameter_pitch: 2 blades, 75 in diameter, 57 in pitch, static RPM limits 2,280-2,400 rpm at sea level standard day: FAA TCDS 3A12 (Model 172P) and EASA/DGAC TCDS A4EU (Reims F172P)
sourced.blade_angle_from_pitch: 57 in at 0.75R is 17.88 deg: atan(57 / (0.75 pi 75)); used as the face angle of the measured maps, and with the 0.75 deg face offset as the blade-element blade's angle
sourced.measured: NACA TR 640 (Hartman & Biermann 1938), 2-blade Clark-Y propeller 5868-9, 10 ft, in front of a liquid-cooled engine nacelle; C_T is effective thrust (shaft tension less the body's slipstream drag increment).

provenance.stand_in: The McCauley 1C160 blade's section and planform are not published. Below J 0.3 the TR 640 5868-9 Clark-Y blade's measured maps stand in for it. From J 0.4 up the maps are propeller_bem.py's of a 57 in constant-pitch helix with the 5868-9 planform (TR 640 Fig. 2) scaled in chord by the same 1.27 McCauley chord factor used on the 1A170E/JHA7660.
provenance.not_met: As on the 1A170E/JHA7660, the McCauley's Cp(J) is flatter than the 5868-9's at cruise J while the TCDS 3A12 static band (2,280-2,400 rpm) anchors static Cp near the 5868-9's, leaving a 9-12 % step between J 0.3 and 0.4 recorded in performance/validation.json.

fitted.chord_scale: 1.27 (peak chord/diameter 0.096 against the 5868-9's 0.076), consistent with the McCauley fixed-pitch family fit on c172s
fitted.blade_angle_deg: searched within 17.88-18.88 deg (sourced 17.88 deg from 57 in geometric pitch at 0.75R plus flat-face camber convention), landing on 18.22 deg to match POH Fig. 5-7 cruise %BHP/KTAS and TCDS 3A12 static RPM (2,280-2,400 rpm)

assumed.face_offset_deg: 0.75 deg between TR 640's flat-face blade angle and the blade-element tool's reference
assumed.mach_fade: tip-Mach power loss fades linearly to zero at J 0.6

tip_mach_correction.source: NACA TR 684 (Hartman & Biermann 1940) Fig. 18, 2-blade 5868-9 at V/nD = 0: (Ct/Cp)/(Ct/Cp at M 0.5) about 0.92 at 17.5 deg and 0.96 at 20 deg for tip Mach 0.68-0.70 (75 in at 2,280-2,400 rpm static).
